verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never states a per-second (or any granular usage-based) billing model; the closest reference is that 'always-on' is a flat add-on (maritime-docs-12) and that agents run on 'serverless infrastructure' (maritime-probe-1), but neither confirms per-second metering of actual compute usage. Missing for 10: explicit pricing documentation describing per-second billing granularity, billing examples, or independent confirmation of usage-based cost calculation.
